proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: given s, t in the Picard functor over T, seek a locally closed Z with the universal property; first reduce (fppf-locally) to the case where s and t come from invertible modules: over an fppf covering {T_i} the restrictions give locally closed Z_i with the universal property, Z_i and Z_j agree on the common base (same scheme-theoretic inverse image), giving a descent datum; the locally quasi-finite morphisms Z_i -> T_i descend to Z -> T by the More on Morphisms lemma, Z -> T is an immersion by the Descent lemma, and the fppf-sheaf property of the Picard functor gives s|_Z = t|_Z and the universal property; in the invertible-module case set L = V x W^-1 and the desired Z is exactly the locus where L_{X_{T'}} is a pullback from T', which exists by the More on Morphisms of Spaces diagonal-Picard lemma (source lines 3282-3320)
